title: Future Universal Creation Machine

source_reference.role: visual direction and semantic reference; not projected or reconstructed geometry

identity_sentence: An optimistic artifact-making civilization has grown around a precise living forge where human intent and machine possibility become reusable worlds.
signature_element: A luminous seed core inside counter-rotating orbital machinery, feeding eight detachable process pylons through visible energy paths.
shape_language: nested orbital arcs and radial gantries
faceted hexagonal ports and readable mechanical joints
layered plates over exposed structural ribs
faceted floating geology with inhabited scale cues
small fasteners, vents, cables and light nodes concentrated near interaction surfaces

composition.secondary_rhythm: eight process pylons around the forge
composition.tertiary_depth: floating-island kit, transit bus and distant creation spires
composition.negative_space: keep the core readable through the rings and preserve gaps between every pylon

motion: counter-rotating orbital rings communicate continuous operation
core breathing and light pulse communicate stored possibility
pylons float with staggered phases so the system feels alive rather than synchronized
islands drift slowly while the cloud-bus and rotors provide faster transport motion
build-pulse clip travels outward from the seed core through the process ring
asset_family: eight detachable process pylons: Intent, Simulation, Test Lanes, Composition, Workflow Discovery, Growth Memory, New Organs, Creation Output
low-cost collision set and three geometry realization levels

detail_pass_v2.goal: Raise close-range authored complexity without changing the accepted machine silhouette or turning detail into undirected polygon noise.
core: containment petals and actuators around the luminous seed
visible guide rollers, brake fins, service scales and braided gantry conduits
layered reactor heatshields, umbilicals and diagnostic lights
pylons: focusing coils, emitter prongs and outward-facing service consoles
structural conduit spines and porcelain energy isolators
environment: load ribs, workshops, roof plates and lamps as inhabited scale cues
hanging root conduits and underside photon crystals
pressure bands, utility rails, service pods, fins and sensor hardware on the cloud bus
non_degradable: detachable named parts and retained construction causes
three descending LOD realizations and low-cost collision

anti_defaults: no color-swap duplicates counted as new atoms
no flattened poster billboard or image projection
no decorative motion without a readable state meaning
no hidden dependency on a model or online service at runtime
no claim that the human and Mir character figures have been reconstructed in this machine-first pack
outputs: editable Blender source retaining named construction parts
animated GLB in LOD0, LOD1 and LOD2 realizations
parts index, assembly recipe, asset manifest and verification receipt
fresh-import multi-angle stills and motion proof
acceptance_cues: the forge reads first at both hero and environment distance
the two orbital rings remain visibly separate in silhouette
all eight pylons are identifiable by different hologram geometry rather than color alone
rear and underside surfaces are authored rather than left as a detailed facade
animations survive GLB export and fresh import
LOD triangle counts descend while the signature silhouette remains intact
every retained part records its semantic family and controlling bone
truth_boundary: This is a deterministic authored UC interpretation of the supplied concept image, not automatic image-to-3D reconstruction.
Unseen surfaces, scale and exact mechanical construction are authored interpretations.
Structural and animation verification do not by themselves establish AAA visual acceptance.
No target-engine gameplay, navigation, networking or character-rig integration claim is made in this pack.
